rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being kept apart from others to prevent disease spread.

example.english: I'm still in quarantine and can't go out yet.

rows.note: Use this for official or institutional disease-control quarantine, especially at borders or under government orders.

example.english: This shipment of imported poultry must undergo quarantine.

rows.note: Use this specifically when quarantine means the period of isolation rather than the measure or state generally.

example.english: My quarantine period is over, so I can finally return to work.
